message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo (18 June 1815) resulted in roughly **23,000 total casualties**—killed, wounded, or missing.  

| Side | Approximate casualties |
|------|------------------------|
| French & allied (Napoleon’s forces) | ~25,000 |
| Anglo‑Dutch & Prussian (Allied forces) | ~20,000 |

These figures are rounded estimates drawn from contemporary military reports and modern historical analyses. The exact numbers vary slightly among sources, but most scholars agree on a total in the low‑to‑mid 20,000s.
